$comment: Controlled vocabulary for /timeline. Tag ids are kebab-case and must not change once used. Every taxonomy category id (data/curated/taxonomy.json) is also a tag here with the same id. Discs are the vinyls a user can put on the turntable; `kind: game` discs match entries by gameId, `kind: collection` discs match entries carrying any of `tags` (or whose gameId is in `gameIds`).
